name: @bm/client
description: Shared Blockchain Melanesia client — BM IdP auth (phone/email/passkey/QR), Supabase custom-OIDC (bridge/accessToken/redirect modes), idle-session timeout, Konekt voucher, the E.164 PhoneInput, Bluetooth ESC/POS printing (@bm/client/print) and the BM PDF look (@bm/client/pdf). The shared BM rewards rail (@bm/client/rewards, server-side) and the standard in-app messages inbox (@bm/client/notices). Configured once per app via configureBm().
